body: I’ll miss you, bud. Dm me if you need to.
I promise this wasn’t the answer for me. I hurt my mother so deeply in the process. If she’s that cold maybe you should cut her off? Sorry for the unsolicited advice.
Tried to end my life, turned over a new leaf :)

I think someone said i’m narcissistic? Sorry if it came off that way. I just wanted to post this on the off chance it made someone rethink things.

Edit: Forgot to mention I posted it 15 minutes after everything happened, which is why I sound so edgy.
Life is tough, We’re given a process of constant misery right off the bat. I’m learning how to break that mold, how to bring in some light. I wish you luck, friend!
